title: The Quiet Vector
author: Ines Eriksen
blurb: Mirabel Thornbury, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
